items.title: Cancellation eligibility follows current fulfillment
items.expected: Eligibility and refusal reason match each current state; submission shows processing rather than a fabricated completed cancellation; no other-customer access.

items.title: Unpaid whole-order and paid line cancellation
items.expected: Unpaid order closes all lines, releases all holds once and requires new quote/order for repurchase. Paid order cancels only eligible line and creates refund pending in original mode, never claims refunded; shipped line unchanged; reason recorded.

items.title: Return, exchange and damage application data
items.expected: Queryable case binds correct line, quantity, type, reason and evidence; exchange identifies target; damage identifies package. Incomplete application identifies missing required data rather than losing it or fabricating evidence.

items.title: After-sales remaining quantity boundary
items.expected: Claims cannot exceed remaining 2 individually or collectively; excess refused with available quantity; already processed units cannot be claimed again.

items.title: Original return-policy time and condition boundary
items.expected: Eligibility uses V1's explicit inclusive/exclusive rule and conditions; disallowed applications show original policy and specific reason, never substitute V2. Undefined boundary semantics are recorded as a missing execution oracle.

items.title: Accept and refuse a return or exchange
items.expected: Decision, reason, reviewer and time persist; customer sees corresponding next step, not the opposite branch or an unexplained status.

items.title: Received goods inspection stays bound to item
items.expected: Received serial/line, condition, evidence and refund/exchange conclusion persist on correct case; mere shipment is not represented as inspected receipt; second case remains unchanged.

items.title: Refund amount limits per unit, line, order and top-up
items.expected: Approval records amount basis, currency, mode and approver; approved amount never exceeds eligible unprocessed quantity or any remaining limit; top-up balance belongs only to its case; current prices cannot inflate original refund.

items.title: Refund dispatch uses original source and mode once
items.expected: One refund per approved allocation via its original mode; separate original-payment and refund references saved. Test creates only isolated simulated refunds and no real receiver request.

items.title: Uncertain refund retains its reservation
items.expected: Case remains pending reconciliation with original reference and reserved amount; same refund is not dispatched again and competing approval cannot spend the reservation.

items.title: Bicycle serial binding uniqueness
items.expected: Serial refers to exact delivered line without duplicate associations; second-line conflict is restricted and first association remains correct.

items.title: Warranty eligibility and insufficient evidence
items.expected: Eligibility reflects published applicable policy and original order snapshot; insufficient data prompts specific supplementation, not an invented approval/refusal; reassessment uses supplied evidence.

items.title: Repair responsibility through return to customer
items.expected: All diagnosis, responsibility, repair/replacement result, fee basis and handback states persist; completion is not inferred from diagnosis alone.

items.title: After-sales adjustments are traceable and nonduplicative
items.expected: Each adjustment names source case; entitlement changes only by remaining justified amount; repeated or overlapping events do not double-adjust; original snapshot is byte/field equivalent at visible export boundary.

items.title: Every allowed after-sales transition and rejected shortcut
items.expected: Exactly listed transitions with prerequisites succeed; skipped review/inspection, unfinished refund, undelivered replacement and unresolved original-item custody cannot reach terminal state. Source and time persist; unavailable illegal controls and rejected boundary requests count as observable rejection.

items.title: Only definitively failed refund allocations can retry
items.expected: Failure reason remains on original case, failed reserve releases once; only failed and reapproved allocation retries; successful money and uncertain reservation remain unchanged.

items.title: Duplicate refund results do not multiply side effects
items.expected: Money, inventory and points adjust once only; duplicate-event reconciliation record is visible to authorized staff.

items.title: Return instructions require all original-policy conditions
items.expected: Instructions use V1 destination, bicycle handling, payer and deadline; each missing input blocks shipping instructions and identifies missing condition; restored complete case provides them.

items.title: Positive, negative and zero exchange price difference
items.expected: Difference compares original refundable amount with current target quote; shipment blocked before confirmation; positive/negative/zero branch stated accurately without silently using original list price.

items.title: Replacement shipment requires the full prerequisite combination
items.expected: Only fully qualified case requests traceable replacement package; stock failure exposes change-target/refund paths; each other missing prerequisite leaves pending case with no replacement package.

items.title: Completion checks the actual promised result
items.expected: Unpaid cancellation needs all lines closed/stock released; refund needs all sources successful; exchange needs replacement delivered; repair needs fulfilled return/disposition; unmet conditions refuse completion and preserve pending state.

items.title: Confirmed refund success converts only its source reserve
items.expected: Only corresponding source reservation becomes refunded balance, once; partial success does not complete case; complete only after both successes; source result evidence and actual/test distinction persist.

items.title: Cancellation cannot release uncertain payment holds
items.expected: Case becomes pending payment reconciliation; inventory stays held, order is not described as cancelled/refunded; reconciliation required before next decision.

items.title: Pre-shipment exchange termination and settlement
items.expected: Target hold releases once; reason/request time/responsible person retained; unrefunded top-up linked to case and original transaction becomes pending refund. Only never-sent original with no refund due can terminate immediately; other cases await settlement; shipped case cannot use this pre-shipment route.

items.title: Exchange settlement positive, negative, zero and uncertain
items.expected: Positive arrangement initiates once, records confirmed amount/currency/mode/reference on success; failure can reconfirm, unknown cannot debit again/ship. Negative settles only all refunds successful; zero records confirmation without money action; original snapshot unchanged.

items.title: Reconcile original refund and top-up attempts
items.expected: Queries original attempt; success/failure follow refund/top-up branches, unknown remains pending with no second refund/debit. Already-successful allocations stay intact.

items.title: Exchange inventory hold happens once after inspection
items.expected: Eligible case gets one linked target hold; no oversell, duplicate hold or premature hold for missing prerequisites; failure remains pending, blocks package and offers change target/refund.

items.title: Terminal states require money AND original-item settlement
items.expected: Terminal allowed only when BOTH obligations settled; unresolved original stays awaiting disposition/termination settlement or original state; failed/unknown money prevents closure; public case shows actual money and disposition records.

items.title: Refund source reservations cannot exceed or cross balances
items.expected: Each allocation binds eligible confirmed source and reserves once; aggregate accepted reservations never exceed that source balance; cross-source or mode borrowing and unconfirmed top-up refused with basis saved.

items.title: Multi-source refund aggregation precedence
items.expected: Unknown takes precedence, then pending, then failed, then complete only if all success; per-source outcomes retained; successful sources never re-execute and unknown cannot retry; only failed reapproved allocation can retry.

items.title: Exact variant and market in cart
items.expected: Each line shows exact selected variant, quantity, market currency and displayed price; similarly named variants are not substituted.

items.title: Cart quantities, deletion and stock boundary
items.expected: Valid changes preserve line/recalculate subtotal and total; excess rejected; deleting removes only selected line and subtotal; empty cart has no stale total.

items.title: Cart restoration revalidates surviving items
items.expected: Still-valid lines restored; unavailable and changed-price lines clearly identified; old price or stock is not silently represented as current.

items.title: Market switch invalidates old cart quote
items.expected: Every line is rechecked for B; old quote cannot submit unchanged; difference/unavailability shown with correct B currency.

items.title: Guest checkout requires no registration
items.expected: Guest can provide required information and proceed; no mandatory account creation or hidden login gate.

items.title: Member saved and new address choice
items.expected: Chosen address is used correctly; new address entry works; B's addresses never offered.

items.title: Address validation across delivery coverage
items.expected: Missing fields and uncovered destination identified; invalid destination cannot advance as deliverable; corrected covered address proceeds.

items.title: Delivery choices and justified estimates
items.expected: Only applicable options with rule-derived fee and supported estimate appear; customer choice is explicit and reflected in quote; stale service not retained when inapplicable.

items.title: Promotion eligibility, expiry and stacking
items.expected: Eligible discount matches rule; invalid/expired/inapplicable reasons distinct; forbidden stacking or exhausted quota cannot reduce total.

items.title: Itemized quote with tax, zero tax and missing rules
items.expected: Goods, discounts, applicable points, shipping, tax, total and currency reconcile; zero shows basis; missing tax basis blocks payable quote rather than assuming zero.

items.title: Quote change requires fresh confirmation
items.expected: Old/new differences shown and fresh customer confirmation required; unavailable stock cannot proceed; declining cannot create payment at new total.

items.title: Missing business inputs block payment
items.expected: No payment dispatch for each gap; affected destination/item/mode and missing business condition shown; configuration absence not converted into a default policy.

items.title: Payment rechecks mode and every line readiness
items.expected: Only ready corresponding mode invoked; any unready real line blocks whole payment; ready test routes isolated simulation with explicit label and zero real requests.

items.title: Successful payment confirms money and used benefits once
items.expected: Order becomes paid with correct mode/confirmed amount/currency/reference; only used holds convert once, no partial visible state where paid order retains unconfirmed used benefit; test money not real receipts.

items.title: Definitive failure releases exactly the used holds
items.expected: Failure status and retryable checkout retained; inventory and actual used benefits release once; unused benefits unaffected, no paid claim.

items.title: Repeated quote and payment events have one effect
items.expected: One pending order and one set of holds; each result creates one payment/benefit use or reversal effect tied to original attempt; independent genuine quotes remain distinct.

items.title: Failed-payment retry creates newly confirmed order
items.expected: Current price/availability checked; new related pending order/holds only after confirmation; original failed order and snapshot unchanged; unavailable item blocks retry order.

items.title: Test checkout never implies real charge
items.expected: Before and after payment explicitly says test/no real charge; simulated success not real receipt or real-shipping authorization; receiver has no real debit.

items.title: Order and all required holds succeed or fail together
items.expected: Success saves snapshot and same-mode holds together. Any required failure produces no payable order or payment and no orphan holds, identifies affected line/reason, never borrows live resources for test.

items.title: Uncertain payment blocks second charge and shipping
items.expected: Order remains pending reconciliation with original reference, staff task and holds; no second charge or physical fulfillment; elapsed deadline alone does not release holds.

items.title: Confirmed money with broken original state stays exceptional
items.expected: Affected case stays unresolved with staff task until repair or successful refund; no second charge or physical fulfillment meanwhile; absent unused benefits must not manufacture an exception.

items.title: Hold deadline distinguishes unstarted from uncertain payment
items.expected: Verified-unstarted order expires at configured boundary and releases inventory/used benefits once; before deadline stays valid; uncertain payment never auto-releases even after T.

items.title: Original payment reconciliation all outcomes
items.expected: Queries original reference; valid success paid, invalid success repair/refund exception, failure releases, unknown holds/no second charge; no unrelated order advanced.

items.title: Published content follows active language
items.expected: Lists include only published content in active language and correct category; no draft/withdrawn leakage.

items.title: Article metadata and related published products
items.expected: Title, complete body and publication time match published version; related product links lead to published products, not private drafts.

items.title: Draft and withdrawn content hidden at every public entry
items.expected: No nonpublic body exposed on public routes; withdrawal keeps staff-visible history.

items.title: Authorized external video entry
items.expected: Title and cover/alternative visible; playback entry usable; external source identified accurately.

items.title: Video failure does not hide article
items.expected: Understandable video fallback; article text remains readable and navigable without false playback success.

items.title: Draft save and private preview
items.expected: Saved draft revision persists, preview only authorized; public content not prematurely changed.

items.title: Promotion publication scope and remaining capacity
items.expected: Saved rule fields preserved; only qualified customers with unheld quota see usable promise; out-of-scope or capacity-held customers do not.

items.title: Expired, withdrawn and exhausted promotions distinguish held orders
items.expected: New purchase cannot apply unavailable promo or see usable promise; still-valid existing hold honored at confirmed quote rather than retroactively removed.

items.title: Policy pages expose correct market version
items.expected: Every page identifies applicable market, effective version and time; future/other-market version not substituted.

items.title: Publish exposes exact version and time
items.expected: V2 enters public entry with recorded publication time; V1 is not mistakenly published as latest.

items.title: Withdrawal removes published content
items.expected: Withdrawal time persists and content stops being public while staff history remains.

items.title: Promotion total and customer quotas under contention
items.expected: Accepted holds never exceed either cap; each tied to order/mode; test does not consume live quota; losing checkout gets no payable order with missing quota.

items.title: Promotion use confirms only paid associated order once
items.expected: First hold converts once to used; second untouched until its verified success; no double decrement on duplicate success.

items.title: Promotion release legal reasons and uncertain control
items.expected: Only first three release their own quota once; uncertain payment retains quota; other order unaffected.

items.title: Verified registration rejects invalid and duplicate identity
items.expected: Only verified valid identity is established; duplicate/invalid identity cannot occupy another account; correct verified visitor can proceed.

items.title: Credential validation and private session scope
items.expected: Wrong login creates no private session; valid login accesses A only, B remains inaccessible.

items.title: Guest order access needs channel control
items.expected: No ownership authorization until control verified; valid proof permits only corresponding order actions; guessed facts cannot expose order data.

items.title: Own profile read and edit isolation
items.expected: A changes persist with verifiable history; B untouched and private; unauthorized responses do not return B fields.

items.title: Address add, edit, delete and ownership
items.expected: Only requested A records change and deleted A2 no longer selectable; A3 persists; unauthorized users cannot read A addresses.

items.title: Favorites survive sessions and catalog changes
items.expected: A selections survive sessions, retained variants show unlisted/out-of-stock state; removal persists; B list unaffected.

items.title: Order history ownership
items.expected: Only assigned A orders summarized and queryable; no implicit claim of unrelated guest order; empty history does not leak other users.

items.title: Review qualification and duplicate line protection
items.expected: One effective review per qualified purchased line, with score/text/line and pending-review status; ineligible/foreign submissions not accepted as valid reviews.

items.title: Review moderation governs public display
items.expected: Decisions/reasons recorded; only published review appears, pending/rejected text hidden from public.

items.title: Points earning at the qualifying state
items.expected: Exactly one traceable award for qualifying order under its currency/rule; premature/disqualified order earns none; repeat does not duplicate and test/live remain separate.

items.title: Points balance reconciles all event types
items.expected: Visible balance nonnegative and reconciles ledger; source orders and acquire/use/reverse/expiry records distinguishable, without hiding negative arithmetic behind misleading balance.

items.title: Points redemption currency and available balance
items.expected: Only unheld eligible balance available under published currency conversion; excessive/unsupported redemption cannot lower payable amount; associated order recorded.

items.title: Points reversals across overlapping qualification events
items.expected: Failure releases uncommitted redemption without award; cancel/refund adjust only actual eligible scope and outstanding delta; duplicate or overlapping events never reverse same entitlement twice.

items.title: Disabled points plan has no promises
items.expected: No redeemable-points display or earning promise while disabled; stale entry cannot silently apply points.

items.title: Logout revokes private access
items.expected: Former session no longer authorizes private data; stale UI does not grant subsequent read/write access.

items.title: Credential reset proves ownership and expires old credentials
items.expected: Only verified registered-channel holder resets; old credential and expired reset proof rejected; new credential authenticates intended account.

items.title: Points reservations account/currency/mode boundaries
items.expected: One correctly scoped hold per order; total never exceeds unheld A balance, no borrowing B/other currency/live pool; record includes order and mode.

items.title: Points redemption finalizes once on verified payment
items.expected: A hold becomes one actual-use event; B not finalized; customer balance and reserved amount reconcile without duplicate deduction.

items.title: Points release only legal order-specific holds
items.expected: Only respective legal hold releases once; uncertain and unrelated holds remain; no new points created by repeated release.

items.title: Support availability is truthful
items.expected: Online/offline indicator agrees with service, usable contact routes shown without claiming unavailable staff online.

items.title: Online message persists for both participants
items.expected: Message durably visible in correct conversation to both with accurate send state; no lost message after refresh or unrelated-conversation delivery.

items.title: Offline message and reachable contact
items.expected: Valid message creates saved follow-up conversation and explains reply route; no false live-delivery claim; contact sufficient for stated route.

items.title: Reconnect requires identity and restores only own history
items.expected: After verification A history restored including pre-disconnect messages; unverified/foreign history not exposed.

items.title: Order association checks guest/member ownership
items.expected: Only verified guest or owner-member order can link; only authorized support sees necessary summary, no unrelated full customer details.

items.title: New conversations become visible unassigned work
items.expected: New conversations marked unassigned and visible to authorized personnel; unauthorized customer details not exposed.

items.title: Concurrent assignment leaves one notified owner
items.expected: At each observable settled state exactly one responsible agent; notification matches effective assignment, no competing active owners.

items.title: Transfer carries unfinished work and audit
items.expected: Original owner, new owner, reason/time recorded; B receives unfinished state and history, work not marked resolved or left with two owners.

items.title: New message reopens closed conversation
items.expected: Pending follow-up restored; original history retained and new message included, not silently lost in closed state.

items.title: Notification event matrix and next-step links
items.expected: Corresponding status, payment mode where relevant, and next action correct; link leads to authorized correct record; old/other customer's status never substituted.

items.title: Guest notifications use checkout channel
items.expected: Guest receives through checkout contact without account inbox dependency; correct guest order route and ownership challenge preserved.

items.title: Notification retry has no repeated business action
items.expected: Failure cause and retryable state retained; delivery retry never repeats payment/refund/shipment or original state transition.

items.title: Absent and broken notification channels surface pending work
items.expected: Authorized staff sees actionable pending channel exception; no claim customer received undelivered message.

items.title: Empty agent workspace is understandable
items.expected: Explicit select-conversation or wait-for-assignment instruction; no stale customer's conversation shown as current.

items.title: Workspace load failure and recovery
items.expected: Visible fault with usable retry; retry actually loads authorized workspace, not endless false success or blank panel.

items.title: Forbidden conversation access has safe return path
items.expected: B content refused/not disclosed; return reaches authorized queue, not another forbidden or stale conversation.

items.title: Assigned agent reply survives reconnect
items.expected: Authorized replies persist sender/content/time and are readable live or after re-entry; unauthorized reply cannot appear as valid assigned-agent reply.

items.title: Readiness inventory by market and affected scope
items.expected: No market explicitly reported; each category status and gap names affected variants/destinations; no generic green status concealing a scoped missing input.

items.title: Variant readiness and market with zero tradable goods
items.expected: Readiness tied to each variant and its missing input; market with no passing variant explicitly has no tradable goods, not ready merely because catalog exists.

items.title: Media authorization scope does not overblock commerce
items.expected: Affected media/content flagged with missing proof; A gap blocks A transaction; unrelated video gap does not block ready B transaction.

items.title: Effective rules apply to affected destinations and goods
items.expected: Affected destination/product marked unready with exact checkout blocker; future rule not treated effective; unaffected valid combination remains ready.

items.title: Payment readiness distinguishes real from test
items.expected: Only verified real with working money/refund route qualifies for real readiness; labeled test only test; invalid/unconfirmed configurations unready with specific missing confirmation.

items.title: Communication readiness identifies customer routes
items.expected: Each missing/unusable service marked unready with affected contact path; presence of config alone not claimed working.

items.title: Runtime readiness requires verifiable operation evidence
items.expected: Every absent verification yields corresponding risk and action; backup record alone cannot stand for recovery verification; complete evidence discoverable.

items.title: Fixing a readiness gap triggers scoped recheck
items.expected: Related status recomputed from result, verifier/time/result retained; B not cleared; failed recheck not recorded ready merely because input saved.

items.title: Test workflows cannot mutate live business state
items.expected: Test source labeled and all money/order/stock/benefits/reviews/metrics segregated; no live debit/refund/shipment or live mutable effect; product reference remains read-only.

items.title: Readiness per market, variant and destination combination
items.expected: Only fully passing combinations ready; market summary none/partial/all accurate; local gap does not block unrelated combination, shared gap blocks its market, test payment never satisfies real requirement.

items.title: Test readiness requires isolated usable resources
items.expected: Ready only with all applicable checks verifiable; unused benefits not mandatory; no fallback to live stock/rights, simulated success not real-sale readiness.

items.title: Mixed cart readiness is all-or-nothing at payment
items.expected: Any failing line blocks entire charge and names line; no public real-purchase promise for failing line; A alone remains purchasable when ready; changing destination rechecks combination.

items.title: Bicycle assembly inputs are model-specific prerequisites
items.expected: Each A gap names missing input and prevents A real sale; complete B unaffected; accessory-only market not blocked by inapplicable bicycle requirements.

items.title: Enabled market language and quote currency
items.expected: Current market, applicable language and quote currency visible and consistent with that market, not stale previous setting.

items.title: Market switch changes product availability and quotes
items.expected: B sellable set and independent quotes shown; prior V2 unavailable and V1 change marked; no stale A currency/price.

items.title: Disabled market cannot checkout
items.expected: D explains region unavailable and offers no D checkout path; enabled E remains usable.

items.title: Catalog publication, category and stock
items.expected: Configured categories and only published products displayed; out-of-stock clearly marked, drafts excluded.

items.title: Product details distinguish evidence and absent image
items.expected: All required fields accurately visible, specs backed by supplied data; no-image explicit instead of fabricated image; conditions not omitted.

items.title: Variant selection updates identity and price
items.expected: Selected unique ID/spec/price/availability all agree; last variant not accidentally reused.

items.title: Unavailable variants cannot enter orders or exchange holds
items.expected: No new payable order or exchange hold for unavailable variant; reason distinguishes market exclusion from shortage/available quantity.

items.title: Create unpublished and edit selected product only
items.expected: New records identifiable and unpublished; specified categories/specs/market/price/media source/status saved; other records unchanged.

items.title: Publishing rejects missing evidence
items.expected: Each gap prevents publication with named missing field/evidence; complete genuine data can publish; another category's specs cannot substitute.

items.title: Inventory adjustments preserve before/after audit
items.expected: V1 before/after, reason, operator and time match action; V2 count unchanged.

items.title: Inventory reservation source and mode isolation
items.expected: Only corresponding-mode V1 availability decreases; history traces order/line or original line/case/target; V2 and opposite-mode pools unchanged; absent test pool cannot borrow live.

items.title: Stock release is source-specific and idempotent
items.expected: Only associated variant/mode quantity restored once; invalid/uncertain release does not inflate stock; unrelated holds preserved.

items.title: Orders and exchanges compete for remaining stock
items.expected: Accepted total never exceeds 1; excess part refused with availability/shortage; no extra payable order/fulfillable exchange or cross-variant borrowing.

items.title: Broken or unavailable media has explicit fallback
items.expected: Clear no-image state, no broken-image glyph or unlicensed substitute; product information readable.

items.title: Assembly conditions visible before payable quote
items.expected: Complete model shows every required pre-purchase condition and working policy entry; incomplete model explicitly warns and cannot form payable quote.

items.title: Controlled first-administrator initialization
items.expected: First personal identifiable admin established only by controlled process; unauthorized/repeated initialization cannot create replacement or extra admin.

items.title: Employee creation has individual identity and provenance
items.expected: Personal employee identity, creator and creation time saved rather than a shared untraceable account.

items.title: Role grants and revocation affect existing sessions
items.expected: Grant allows matching action; revocation immediately blocks subsequent action in all existing sessions; role change history recorded.

items.title: Unauthorized staff operations leave records unchanged
items.expected: All forbidden actions refused without business-record changes or private fields; authorized control can perform permitted counterpart.

items.title: Product staff can edit only authorized fields
items.expected: Only granted product/variant/market-price/publication fields changed through catalog behavior; unauthorized field and P2 preserved.

items.title: Stocktaking requires reason
items.expected: Missing reason prevents adjustment; accepted adjustment retains before/after/count delta, cause, operator and time.

items.title: Fulfillment queue respects scope and legal progression
items.expected: Only authorized work visible; legal update persists, invalid state jump blocked, unrelated records unchanged.

items.title: After-sales role boundaries per action
items.expected: Only corresponding role permissions permit action; denial leaves case unchanged; accepted action records decision basis.

items.title: Support manager queue privacy
items.expected: Only accessible assignable/transferable tasks and necessary data shown; unprivileged customer details hidden.

items.title: Rule version, scope, effective time and required values
items.expected: Scope/time/version/operator persisted; incomplete rules cannot activate; applicable effective version used, not merely last edited.

items.title: Sensitive actions create staff-immutable audit
items.expected: Each event has accountable sensitive-change record; ordinary employee cannot delete/alter it; original event still viewable.

items.title: Business summaries separate market/time and test activity
items.expected: Metrics match included records and distinguish test from real; wrong market/time or test transactions cannot inflate real totals.

items.title: Exception metrics lead to reconcilable work queues
items.expected: Queue supports verifying corresponding metric with consistent scope; no unrelated default queue or missing contributing exception.

items.title: Employee deactivation blocks existing access
items.expected: Actor/time recorded; every subsequent access blocked, including old session; protected business state unchanged.

items.title: Employee reset requires controlled identity proof
items.expected: Initiator/time recorded; reset cannot complete before verified identity; valid employee can finish through controlled channel.

items.title: Order snapshot preserves exact allocation and policy
items.expected: Order ID/owner-contact/time, exact variants/quantities/prices/currency, per-unit discount/points/tax/shipping and rounding recipient, tax basis, address/service/fee/estimate, total/mode/policy versions all preserved; unit allocations sum to quoted totals.

items.title: Catalog and policy updates do not rewrite history
items.expected: Old order's complete transaction snapshot unchanged; new quote reflects current values without overwriting history.

items.title: Guest, member and employee order visibility
items.expected: Only authorized owner/employee sees current states and event times; other identities refused, guest number alone insufficient.

items.title: Order state dimensions progress without illegal jumps
items.expected: Only permitted qualified edge changes its dimension; failed/expired retries create related new order; refund does not erase paid/shipping history; transport exception is annotation, after-sales request is not cancellation/refund.

items.title: Picking requires verified payment and physical authorization
items.expected: Qualified lines show their picking/ready status; unpaid/unknown cannot advance and test success alone cannot authorize physical fulfillment.

items.title: Bicycle packaging checks include failures
items.expected: Applicable checks, performer and actual abnormal result retained on correct package, failure not silently converted to all-pass.

items.title: Assembly responsibilities and accompanying guide
items.expected: Correct model/policy-specific responsibilities and actual guide recorded and available; merchant work not misattributed to customer or vice versa.

items.title: Mixed bicycle and accessory split delivery
items.expected: Each package/line status independent and each item's expected arrival identifiable; first shipment does not falsely mark all shipped.

items.title: Shipment records expose carrier and update time
items.expected: Correct carrier/tracking/time/evidence persist for dispatched package; customer sees update time, second package unaffected.

items.title: Unavailable tracking never invents delivery
items.expected: Source and last update clearly shown; failure/no data not delivered; recovery displays actual subsequent status.

items.title: Verified delivery updates only matching package
items.expected: First records source/time and delivered status; second unchanged until its own verifiable delivery, no order-wide fabricated arrival.

items.title: Transport damage links exact package and case
items.expected: Report preserves correct package/item/description/evidence/time; queryable linked case, accessory not mistakenly implicated.

items.title: Simulated payment cannot authorize physical shipping
items.expected: Physical dispatch task rejected and no real carrier request; test-payment status explicitly not authorization.

items.title: Repeated fulfillment events stay single-effect
items.expected: No duplicate business effect or state regression from repetitions; single package not dispatched twice or counted delivered twice.

items.title: Aggregate order status preserves partial histories
items.expected: Partial/all shipping, delivery and cancellation accurately derived; refund/after-sales displayed separately; earlier events and per-line reality retained.

items.title: Replacement package independent from original
items.expected: New independent package links original line, case and exact target variant; only replacement follows its actual progress, original history preserved.

items.title: Search includes only matching current-market published items
items.expected: Results relevant and restricted to current market published products; empty result explicit with usable browse entry.

items.title: Filters combine conjunctively and clear independently
items.expected: Every displayed item satisfies remaining combined filters; clearing one preserves others and restores only newly eligible items; boundary inclusion matches stated filter.

items.title: Sorting preserves selected filters
items.expected: Results obey advertised ordering, tied values do not break filtering; filters and membership retained rather than resetting catalog.

items.title: Comparison marks missing specs unknown
items.expected: Correct products/specs aligned; missing value explicitly unknown, not zero or copied from other product.

items.title: Sizing information corresponds to model and variant
items.expected: Applicable size ranges, geometry and model/variant attribution match supplied data, not stale or generalized dimensions.

items.title: Fit recommendation follows provided rule
items.expected: Returned candidate frame sizes and explanation match provided rule; recommendation changes when a rule-relevant input changes.

items.title: Ambiguous, out-of-range and incomplete sizing
items.expected: Boundary shows justified candidate sizes and posture checks; out-of-range says not applicable/manual confirmation; missing input named; none claims uniquely correct size.

items.title: Compatibility conclusion names exact verified variants
items.expected: Verified conclusion, exact model/spec and source or verification time shown; other variant's conclusion not reused.

items.title: Unsupported compatibility is not promised
items.expected: Cannot-confirm state with specific missing spec, last verification time or variant mismatch; usable specification/support path, no unsupported compatibility guarantee.

items.title: Updating fit data refreshes public conclusion
items.expected: Updated metadata persists and affected public conclusion follows effective data; control model unchanged and obsolete conclusion not retained.

items.title: Desktop and narrow-screen complete main workflows
items.expected: Required content and actions visible and completable without horizontal obstruction; no lost totals, hidden submit control or inaccessible staff queue after reflow. Evidence includes task completion at each viewport.

items.title: Consistent product presentation across main pages
items.expected: Typography/color/image proportions/spacing/hierarchy consistently communicate products and actions; stretched images, clipped labels or visually indistinguishable primary action fail qualitative review.

items.title: Keyboard-only complete main flows
items.expected: Visible focus, logical traversal and usable controls permit task completion; no keyboard trap or unreachable critical action; recording shows focus progression.

items.title: Assistive reading of inputs, images and changing status
items.expected: Meaningful labels/appropriate alternatives and perceivable changed status/fees; user can identify field/error/result without seeing layout; decorative images not misleadingly announced as products.

items.title: Actionable validation and recoverable operation failure
items.expected: Specific problem identified and working correction/retry path; valid continuation succeeds without unexplained blank state or loss of necessary context.

items.title: Public content is indexable with unique metadata
items.expected: Readable URL, page-specific title/description, indexable substantive text and correct canonical; no all-pages-identical title or canonical to unrelated page.

items.title: Private and nonpublic pages are not advertised to crawlers
items.expected: Excluded route classes absent from public sitemap and never declare themselves indexable; public discovery does not reveal unpublished/private content.

items.title: Cross-user resource access does not leak existence
items.expected: Both unauthorized-existent and nonexistent requests avoid sensitive existence/detail disclosures; forbidden data/change unavailable, owner data unchanged.

items.title: Abuse controls and sensitive session protection
items.expected: Configured abuse limits enforced at defined boundary with recoverable legitimate use; credentials/session data protected in transit and exposed browser surfaces per approved policy. Missing thresholds/policy are execution-oracle gaps, not invented defaults.

items.title: Privacy purpose, policy and request entry
items.expected: Approved purpose and applicable policy available; each required request path usable with queryable acknowledgement appropriate to configured process; no claim of immediate deletion where only request is required.

items.title: Responses and ordinary logs redact sensitive data
items.expected: No password/full payment credential/unnecessary personal marker exposed; logs still correlate event/error without secret. Evidence records marker labels/redacted findings, not credential values.

items.title: Interrupted writes and timeouts remain reconcilable
items.expected: Understandable pending/failure state and reconcilable original record retained; retry does not duplicate respective business effect; unknown money result not falsely finalized.

items.title: Persistent critical errors visible to authorized staff
items.expected: Authorized staff sees concrete error, scope and handling status across persistence/resolution; unrelated staff does not gain private data; unresolved error cannot vanish without outcome.

items.title: Backup result records actual coverage and recovery point
items.expected: Actual success/failure, covered dataset scope and declared recovery point saved; failed/incomplete backup never reported as successful full coverage.

items.title: Restore drill verifies recovered business records
items.expected: All four datasets recover to declared point and verifiable drill result saved; merely starting restore not success, missing/inconsistent dataset fails; no production destructive action assumed.

items.title: Published pages match confirmed brand standard
items.expected: Published pages match confirmed standard; deviations documented per page. Without formal standard this conditional execution remains unproven, never self-approved with an invented look.
